source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of balancing parentheses (PDF 99).

blocks.text: Infix expressions mein parentheses (brackets) batate hain ke kaunsa hisab pehle karna hai. Balancing parentheses ka matlab hai yeh check karna ke har khulne wale bracket ( ke saath us ka band karne wala bracket ) bhi ho.

items: Khulne wale brackets ka hisab rakhne ke liye stack istemal karein.
Khulne wala bracket ( mile to use stack par push karein.
Band karne wala bracket ) mile to stack ka top pop karein.
Saare brackets parhne ke baad stack khali ho to brackets balanced hain.
Agar aakhir mein stack khali na ho, ya khali stack se pop karne ki koshish ho, to brackets balanced nahi.

blocks.text: Misal: (3 + 4) * (5 - 2) mein brackets balanced hain, kyunke har ( ka apna ) hai.

Yeh program stack se check karta hai ke expression ke brackets balanced hain ya nahi. expression badal kar Run karein, maslan "(a + b)) * (c" ya "((3 + 4)", aur dekhein jawab kab NOT balanced aata hai.

expression = "(3 + 4) * (5 - 2)"

stack, balanced = list(), True
for ch in expression:
    if ch == "(":
        stack.append(ch)                  # push
    elif ch == ")":
        if not stack:                     # pop from an empty stack
            balanced = False
            break
        stack.pop()
if stack:                                 # something left at the end
    balanced = False
print(expression, "-> balanced" if balanced else "-> NOT balanced")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"expression = "(3 + 4) * (5 - 2)"": jis expression ke brackets check karne hain.
"stack, balanced = list(), True": khali stack, aur shuru mein maan lete hain ke brackets balanced (barabar) hain.
"for ch in expression:": expression ka har character (harf) baari baari dekhta hai.
"if ch == "(": stack.append(ch)": har khulne wala bracket push.
"elif ch == ")": ...": band bracket par agar stack khali hai to matlab is ka koi joda nahi: balanced = False aur break se loop foran ruk jata hai. Warna ek "(" pop kar ke joda mila deta hai.
"if stack: balanced = False": aakhir mein bhi koi "(" bacha ho to woh band nahi hua, is liye NOT balanced.
Aakhri print: "a if shart else b" ka matlab hai: shart True ho to a, warna b. balanced True hai to "-> balanced" chhapta hai.
Output: (3 + 4) * (5 - 2) -> balanced — do brackets khule, dono band hue, stack aakhir mein khali.
Khud try karein: expression = "((3 + 4)" kar ke Run karein: aakhir mein ek "(" stack mein bach jata hai, is liye "((3 + 4) -> NOT balanced" aayega.
